candidate.title: HANRAG: Noise-Resistant RAG for Multi-hop QA
candidate.description:
In this AI Research Roundup episode, Alex discusses the paper:
'HANRAG: Heuristic Accurate Noise-resistant Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-hop Question Answering'
HANRAG introduces a Revelator agent that routes queries, decomposes compound questions, and refines sub-queries for efficient multi-hop retrieval. It tackles three issues in RAG: inefficiency on compound queries, irrational querying with unchanged complex prompts, and noise accumulation from irrelevant documents. The framework enables asynchronous retrieval for independent sub-queries and synchronous iterative retrieval for chained reasoning. A noise-resistant pipeline (ANRAG) filters passages via relevance discrimination before LLM generation.
Paper URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.09713
